steps.title: pdftotext (poppler-utils)
steps.command:
pdftotext input.pdf output.txt
pdftotext -layout input.pdf output.txt
pdftotext -f 1 -l 5 input.pdf output.txt  # Pages 1-5
steps.explanation: The step calls a binary that a fresh machine does not have; the skill never says to install it. (needs `poppler-utils`)
steps.fix_command:
sudo apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1; sudo apt-get install -y -qq poppler-utils >/dev/null 2>&1 && pdftotext input.pdf output.txt
pdftotext -layout input.pdf output.txt
pdftotext -f 1 -l 5 input.pdf output.txt  # Pages 1-5
